name: knightcrawler25/GLSL-PathTracer
description: Toy physically based GPU path tracer running in GLSL fragment shaders (C++/OpenGL), featuring Disney BSDF, multiple light types, image-based lighting, and importance sampling. Popular teaching and experimentation platform.
score_rationale: 2k-star GPU path tracer accessible via GLSL/OpenGL without requiring RTX hardware, popular for learning PBR techniques.
summary: GPU path tracer in GLSL with Disney BSDF, supporting learning without RTX hardware.
